checks.criterion: Backend: share link mints token and serves site publicly, not indexable
checks.name: test_tscheck_share_link.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/projects/22089b5f-.../share -> 200; GET https://imported-repos-hub.preview.emergentagent.com<share path> -> 200 with HTML body and X-Robots-Tag: noindex; GET /api/share/deadbeefdeadbeef -> 404. 2/2 assertions passed in test_share_link.py.

checks.criterion: Backend: a running build shows step-by-step progress and can be stopped
checks.name: test_tscheck_build_progress_stop.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/chat {text:'Un site pour mon food truck a Lille (tscheck-progress-stop)'} -> 200 in <2s, project.generating=true; GET /api/projects/{id} exposes progress/progress_step fields; POST /api/projects/{id}/stop -> 200, generating=false, assistant message contains 'stop'.

checks.criterion: Picking a service from the catalogue rail attaches a chip, no build starts
checks.name: service-chip-attach-no-build
checks.evidence: Clicked service-barbershop then service-restaurant; composer-chip-barbershop and composer-chip-restaurant appeared, hero-section stayed visible, chat-stream count=0. composer-chip-remove-barbershop removed only that chip, composer-chip-restaurant remained.

checks.criterion: Service rail shows a subset with working arrows and hidden scrollbar
checks.name: service-rail-scroll-arrows
checks.evidence: 9 service buttons found, rail scrollWidth > clientWidth (not all visible). services-next increased scrollLeft, services-prev decreased it back. Rail has no-scrollbar class / scrollbar-width:none.

checks.criterion: Paperclip opens Image/File popover before file dialog, options readable
checks.name: attach-picker-popover
checks.evidence: attach-file-button click showed attach-picker with attach-image-option and attach-document-option visible; opacity>0.9 and background not transparent.

checks.criterion: AI question round renders as a panel above composer with 4-5 questions, multi-select, custom answer, progress, gated launch button
checks.name: question-panel-above-composer
checks.evidence: Seed fixture 'Un site pour mon salon de coiffure a Lyon' (id 1ddb9781-...) no longer has an unanswered questions message: GET /api/projects/1ddb9781-c8e9-41e8-be95-84908c260b6d shows messages kinds [text, questions, text(answers already submitted), site] -- the questions round was already answered and a site already delivered before this test session started, so no question-panel-<id> renders anymore (panelCount=0 confirmed in DOM scan). Per budget rules I did not trigger a new POST /api/chat to regenerate an unanswered question round (only one new build is allowed per session, already spent on the progress/stop backend test). Structural panel/positioning logic could not be exercised against this stale fixture.

checks.criterion: Delivered site presented as file card with thumbnail/metadata/actions and no download button anywhere
checks.name: delivery-card-no-download
checks.evidence: Opened 'Le Barbier du Port'; site-delivery-card-<id> contains site-thumbnail-<id>, filename ending .html, text includes 'sections', 'kb', 'ready'; preview-btn-, open-site-btn-, copy-link-btn-, request-change-btn- all visible; 0 elements with data-testid containing 'download'; body text has no 'Download'.

checks.criterion: Live preview renders generated site fully styled (Tailwind script not link), nav flex, images not broken, mobile/desktop viewport toggle works, no 'Blocked script execution' console errors
checks.name: live-preview-styled-and-viewport
checks.evidence: preview-btn opened site-preview-iframe-<id>; inside iframe computed nav display = 'flex'; 0 broken images (naturalWidth>0 for all complete images); viewport-mobile-btn narrowed iframe to <=390px, viewport-desktop-btn restored >390px width; 0 'Blocked script execution' console errors collected.

checks.criterion: Copy link produces a share URL with toast (validity date) and 'Copied' label
checks.name: copy-link-toast-and-share
checks.evidence: copy-link-btn-<id> click produced toast text matching /day|expire|valid/i, and button label changed to match /copied/i.

checks.criterion: Mobile layout (390x844) is usable: header wordmark, sidebar-open-button, chat-stream, composer visible, no horizontal overflow
checks.name: mobile-layout-no-overflow
checks.evidence: At 390x844: app-header visible containing 'LevelUp', sidebar-open-button visible; opened mobile-sidebar, selected 'Le Barbier du Port'; chat-stream and composer both visible; document.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth+2.

action_items.description: Seed project 'Un site pour mon salon de coiffure a Lyon' (id 1ddb9781-c8e9-41e8-be95-84908c260b6d) was described in the briefing as having an unanswered questions message for question-panel testing, but by the time this test session ran, its question round had already been answered and its site already delivered (confirmed via GET /api/projects/{id} message kinds). This left no way to verify the question-panel-above-composer criterion against seeded state without spending a new AI budget call, which is restricted to at most one new build per session (already used for the build-progress/stop backend test). Recommend either: (a) re-seed a fresh project with an unanswered questions message before the next test pass, or (b) grant one additional budgeted POST /api/chat call specifically for this criterion in a future iteration.

notes: A side effect of the build-progress/stop backend test is a new project 'Votre Site Food Truck à Lille' now appears in the sidebar (created via POST /api/chat then immediately stopped). This is expected residue from that test's own fixture, not seeded/mutated data, and does not affect other checks.
